title: Yap – OSS on-device voice dictation for macOS with no model to download
claim: Show HN: Yap – OSS on-device voice dictation for macOS with no model to download
why_good: Yap enables seamless voice dictation directly on macOS, allowing users to dictate text into any application without needing an internet connection or downloading heavy models. It operates entirely on-device, utilizing Apple's Speech framework for real-time transcription.
value: Developers and professionals seeking efficient, on-device dictation without compromising speed or privacy will pay for Yap to enhance their productivity.
risk: Yap may struggle against established voice dictation software that offers broader features or integrations, especially if users prioritize extensive functionality over simplicity.
